This directory contains source vendored from gposingway/sharingway:
https://github.com/gposingway/sharingway

That repository's README states an MIT license (badge + explicit statement
in its "License" section, referencing a LICENSE file), but as of the commit
this was vendored from, no LICENSE file actually exists in the repository
itself to copy verbatim -- checked directly via `git ls-files`, not assumed.

This notice exists so that's flagged plainly rather than presenting a
fabricated file as if it were an authoritative copy. If this matters for
your use case, the safest path is confirming directly with gposingway
(e.g. via a repository issue) rather than relying on this notice alone.
